purpose: The Scottish Government's average Band D council tax for 2024-25 in each of the 32 council areas, from CTAS 2026 Council Tax Assumptions (the record set scotgov.ctas2026.band_d.fy2024; the local_authority level leaves out its Scotland row). Read through uk_runtime.council_tax_band_d, which merges it with England's and Wales's 2024-25 Band D (council_tax_band_d_england_wales_2024_25.json) over the Great Britain codes of local_authority_names.json for council-tax localisation (microcosm#931).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
